require 'fastlane_core/command_executor'
require 'fastlane_core/configuration/configuration'
require 'fastlane/helper/s3_client_helper'
require 'base64'
require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'spaceship'

require_relative '../options'
require_relative '../module'
require_relative './interface'

module Match
  module Storage
    # Store the code signing identities on AWS S3
    class S3Storage < Interface
      attr_reader :s3_bucket
      attr_reader :s3_region
      attr_reader :s3_client
      attr_reader :s3_object_prefix
      attr_reader :readonly
      attr_reader :username
      attr_reader :team_id
      attr_reader :team_name
      attr_reader :api_key_path
      attr_reader :api_key

      IDENTITY_EXTENSIONS = %w[.cer .p12 .mobileprovision .provisionprofile].freeze

      def self.configure(params)
        s3_region = params[:s3_region]
        s3_access_key = params[:s3_access_key]
        s3_secret_access_key = params[:s3_secret_access_key]
        s3_bucket = params[:s3_bucket]
        s3_object_prefix = params[:s3_object_prefix]

        if params[:git_url].to_s.length > 0
          UI.important("Looks like you still define a `git_url` somewhere, even though")
          UI.important("you use S3 Storage. You can remove the `git_url`")
          UI.important("from your Matchfile and Fastfile")
          UI.message("The above is just a warning, fastlane will continue as usual now...")
        end

        return self.new(
          s3_region: s3_region,
          s3_access_key: s3_access_key,
          s3_secret_access_key: s3_secret_access_key,
          s3_bucket: s3_bucket,
          s3_object_prefix: s3_object_prefix,
          readonly: params[:readonly],
          username: params[:username],
          team_id: params[:team_id],
          team_name: params[:team_name],
          api_key_path: params[:api_key_path],
          api_key: params[:api_key]
        )
      end

      def initialize(s3_region: nil,
                     s3_access_key: nil,
                     s3_secret_access_key: nil,
                     s3_bucket: nil,
                     s3_object_prefix: nil,
                     readonly: nil,
                     username: nil,
                     team_id: nil,
                     team_name: nil,
                     api_key_path: nil,
                     api_key: nil)
        @s3_bucket = s3_bucket
        @s3_region = s3_region
        @s3_client = Fastlane::Helper::S3ClientHelper.new(access_key: s3_access_key, secret_access_key: s3_secret_access_key, region: s3_region)
        @s3_object_prefix = s3_object_prefix.to_s
        @readonly = readonly
        @username = username
        @team_id = team_id
        @team_name = team_name
        @api_key_path = api_key_path
        @api_key = api_key
        @download_inventory = []
        @upload_inventory = []
        @delete_inventory = []
        @storage_warnings = []
        @change_set_files = []
      end

      def prefixed_working_directory
        UI.verbose("Resolving prefixed working directory for S3 bucket #{@s3_bucket}") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
        @_folder_prefix ||= currently_used_team_id
        if @_folder_prefix.nil?
          UI.important("Looks like you run `match` in `readonly` mode, and didn't provide a `team_id`. This will still work, however it is recommended to provide a `team_id` in your Appfile or Matchfile")
          @_folder_prefix = "*"
        end
        return File.join(working_directory, @_folder_prefix)
      end

      def download
        return if @working_directory && Dir.exist?(@working_directory)

        prepare_s3_download_session
        self.working_directory = Dir.mktmpdir

        s3_client.find_bucket!(s3_bucket).objects(prefix: s3_object_prefix).each do |object|
          file_path = strip_s3_object_prefix(object.key) # :s3_object_prefix:team_id/path/to/file

          # strip s3_prefix from file_path
          download_path = File.join(self.working_directory, file_path)

          FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.expand_path("..", download_path))
          UI.verbose("Downloading file from S3 '#{file_path}' on bucket #{self.s3_bucket}")

          object.download_file(download_path)
          record_downloaded_identity_object(object.key, file_path, download_path)
        end
        UI.verbose("Successfully downloaded files from S3 to #{self.working_directory}")
        finalize_s3_download_session
      end

      def human_readable_description
        return "S3 Bucket [#{@s3_bucket}] on region #{@s3_region}"
      end

      def upload_files(files_to_upload: [], custom_message: nil)
        prepare_s3_upload_session(files_to_upload, custom_message)
        files_to_upload.each do |file_name|
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Uploading '#{target_path}' to S3 Storage...")

          body = File.read(file_name)
          acl = 'private'
          s3_url = s3_client.upload_file(@s3_bucket, target_path, body, acl)
          UI.verbose("Uploaded '#{s3_url}' to S3 Storage.")
          record_uploaded_identity_object(file_name, target_path, s3_url)
        end
        finalize_s3_upload_session
      end

      def delete_files(files_to_delete: [], custom_message: nil)
        prepare_s3_delete_session(files_to_delete, custom_message)
        files_to_delete.each do |file_name|
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Deleting '#{target_path}' from S3 Storage...")
          s3_client.delete_file(@s3_bucket, target_path)
          record_deleted_identity_object(file_name, target_path)
        end
        finalize_s3_delete_session
      end

      def skip_docs
        UI.verbose("README generation for S3 bucket #{@s3_bucket} remains enabled") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
        false
      end

      def list_files(file_name: "", file_ext: "")
        UI.verbose("Listing #{@s3_bucket} identities matching #{file_name}*.#{file_ext}") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
        Dir[File.join(@working_directory || working_directory, self.team_id, "**", file_name, "*.#{file_ext}")]
      end

      def generate_matchfile_content(template: nil)
        compose_matchfile_contents(template)
      end

      def save_changes!(files_to_commit: nil, files_to_delete: nil, custom_message: nil)
        files_to_commit ||= []
        files_to_delete ||= []
        track_pending_change_set(files_to_commit, files_to_delete, custom_message)

        Dir.chdir(File.expand_path(self.working_directory)) do
          if files_to_commit.count > 0
            UI.user_error!("You can't provide both `files_to_delete` and `files_to_commit` right now") if files_to_delete.count > 0

            if !File.exist?(MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME) || File.read(MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME) != Fastlane::VERSION.to_s
              files_to_commit << MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME
              File.write(MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME, Fastlane::VERSION)
            end

            template = File.read("#{Match::ROOT}/lib/assets/READMETemplate.md")
            readme_path = "README.md"
            if (!File.exist?(readme_path) || File.read(readme_path) != template) && !self.skip_docs
              files_to_commit << readme_path
              File.write(readme_path, template)
            end

            self.upload_files(files_to_upload: files_to_commit, custom_message: custom_message)
            UI.message("Finished uploading files to #{self.human_readable_description}")
          elsif files_to_delete.count > 0
            self.delete_files(files_to_delete: files_to_delete, custom_message: custom_message)
            UI.message("Finished deleting files from #{self.human_readable_description}")
          else
            UI.user_error!("Neither `files_to_commit` nor `files_to_delete` were provided to the `save_changes!` method call")
          end
        end
        self.clear_changes
      end

      def clear_changes
        return unless @working_directory

        FileUtils.rm_rf(self.working_directory)
        self.working_directory = nil
        @download_inventory = []
        @upload_inventory = []
        @delete_inventory = []
        @change_set_files = []
        UI.verbose("Cleared local working copy for S3 bucket #{@s3_bucket}") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
      end

      def prepare_s3_download_session
        @download_inventory = []
        @storage_warnings = []
        inspect_bucket_configuration
        inspect_object_prefix_configuration
        warmup_bucket_interpreters
      end

      def record_downloaded_identity_object(object_key, file_path, download_path)
        interpretation = interpret_bucket_artifact(file_path, object_key)
        @download_inventory << {
          key: object_key,
          path: file_path,
          destination: download_path,
          bucket: @s3_bucket,
          kind: interpretation
        }
      end

      def finalize_s3_download_session
        @storage_warnings.concat(summarize_bucket_inventory(@download_inventory, "download"))
        UI.verbose("S3 download inventory captured #{@download_inventory.length} object(s) from #{@s3_bucket}") if @download_inventory.length > 0
      end

      def prepare_s3_upload_session(files_to_upload, custom_message)
        @upload_inventory = []
        inspect_bucket_configuration
        describe_bucket_change_message(custom_message, "upload")
        Array(files_to_upload).each do |file_name|
          interpret_bucket_artifact(file_name, s3_object_path(file_name))
        end
      end

      def record_uploaded_identity_object(file_name, target_path, s3_url)
        interpretation = interpret_bucket_artifact(file_name, target_path)
        @upload_inventory << {
          source: file_name,
          key: target_path,
          url: s3_url,
          bucket: @s3_bucket,
          kind: interpretation
        }
      end

      def finalize_s3_upload_session
        @storage_warnings.concat(summarize_bucket_inventory(@upload_inventory, "upload"))
      end

      def prepare_s3_delete_session(files_to_delete, custom_message)
        @delete_inventory = []
        inspect_bucket_configuration
        describe_bucket_change_message(custom_message, "delete")
        Array(files_to_delete).each do |file_name|
          interpret_bucket_artifact(file_name, s3_object_path(file_name))
        end
      end

      def record_deleted_identity_object(file_name, target_path)
        interpretation = interpret_bucket_artifact(file_name, target_path)
        @delete_inventory << {
          source: file_name,
          key: target_path,
          bucket: @s3_bucket,
          kind: interpretation
        }
      end

      def finalize_s3_delete_session
        @storage_warnings.concat(summarize_bucket_inventory(@delete_inventory, "delete"))
      end

      def inspect_bucket_configuration
        name = @s3_bucket.to_s
        if name.strip.empty?
          @storage_warnings << "missing-bucket"
        elsif name.include?(" ")
          @storage_warnings << "bucket-has-whitespace"
        elsif name.length > 63
          @storage_warnings << "bucket-name-long"
        end
      end

      def inspect_object_prefix_configuration
        prefix = @s3_object_prefix.to_s
        if prefix.include?("\\")
          @storage_warnings << "prefix-has-backslash"
        elsif prefix.start_with?("/")
          @storage_warnings << "prefix-absolute"
        elsif prefix.include?("..")
          @storage_warnings << "prefix-parent-segment"
        end
        UI.verbose("Using object prefix '#{prefix}' on bucket #{@s3_bucket}") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
      end

      def track_pending_change_set(files_to_commit, files_to_delete, custom_message)
        @change_set_files = Array(files_to_commit) + Array(files_to_delete)
        describe_bucket_change_message(custom_message, "save")
        @change_set_files.each do |file_name|
          interpret_bucket_artifact(file_name, file_name)
        end
      end

      def compose_matchfile_contents(template)
        bucket_line = "s3_bucket(\"#{@s3_bucket}\")"
        if template.to_s.empty?
          return bucket_line
        elsif template.to_s.include?("s3_bucket")
          return template.to_s
        else
          return [template.to_s.rstrip, bucket_line].join("\n")
        end
      end

      def describe_bucket_change_message(custom_message, action)
        text = custom_message.to_s
        UI.verbose("S3 #{action} on #{@s3_bucket}: #{text}") if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose? && !text.empty?
        text
      end

      def warmup_bucket_interpreters
        self.class.warmup_sample_keys(@s3_object_prefix).each do |key|
          interpret_bucket_artifact(key, key)
        end
      end

      def summarize_bucket_inventory(inventory, action)
        self.class.summarize_identity_inventory(inventory, @s3_bucket, action)
      end

        path_or_key = path_or_key.to_s
